verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gates that change behavior in real time without deploying new code, and Scheduled Rollouts for gradually deploying a feature over time. Its evaluation is documented as deterministic, returning the same result for the same user across client and server, which gives consistent bucketing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of percentage-based allocation (e.g. ramping 1% to 100%), detail on how rollout percentages are configured and adjusted, and independent hands-on corroboration of the rollout workflow.
